# Lapland wellbeing services county: lung cancer gaps and what EUR 1,000,000 a year should buy first

## The gap in one sentence
Lapland has the highest measured lung cancer death rate among residents aged 65+ of 23 counties: 227.0 per 100,000, against 178.6 nationally (2021–2025) [^statfin_13u5]. It also has the lowest measured share of patients given curative-intent treatment, 18.5% against 27.0% nationally (2019–2023) [^fcr_lung_quality_report]. At the top-quartile county rate, about 16.8 more patients a year would get curative-intent treatment (arithmetic on registry shares, not a causal estimate) [^fcr_lung_quality_report]. The model estimates 155 days (142–168) from first symptom to treatment start [^model].

## Where the days are lost
The step furthest above the national value is first symptom to first primary care contact, estimated at 63 days (53–74) against a national 56 [^model]. The model's drivers for this step include:
- 28.6% of residents living in sparsely populated rural areas, against 4.4% nationally [^statfin_11ra]
- 11.4% daily smokers, against 9.1% [^sotkanet_4404]
- an education index of 372.0, against 403.2 [^sotkanet_180]

Diagnosis to treatment start is measured, but only for the Northern Finland (OYS) collaborative area [^src_fi_assets_files_2024_12_Keuhkosyopa_Suomessa_pdf_p28]. Weighted by Lapland's treatment mix it is 29.6 days, against 36.9 nationally (1.1.2018–30.6.2022) [^src_fi_assets_files_2024_12_Keuhkosyopa_Suomessa_pdf_p28].

## Three actions
None of the three top-ranked picks shortens the pathway [^model]. Same-day chest X-ray with immediate CT ranks fourth [^model].

1. **What:** Symptom awareness campaign on the "Be Clear on Cancer" model, telling people with a cough lasting over three weeks to see a doctor [^model]. **Owner:** FICAN and the Cancer Society nationally; county communications and primary care locally. **Cost:** EUR 13,931 a year, scaled from the roadmap's EUR 400,000 national budget; repeating it yearly is an assumption [^model][^roadmap_1.3.2]. **Expected effect:** 0 days saved; estimated 0.58 deaths avoided a year (0.25–0.88) [^model]. **Evidence:** During the English campaign the stage I share of NSCLC rose 3.1 percentage points. This was a before-after comparison, and the regional pilot was not significant [^ev_symptom_campaign_1]. **Roadmap:** 1.3.2, national communication plan on cancer symptoms [^roadmap_1.3.2].

2. **What:** Low-dose CT screening with cessation support for 50–74-year-old long-term heavy smokers [^model]. It needs a national decision; a pilot started in early 2026 [^roadmap_2.3.4]. **Owner:** Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). **Cost:** EUR 548,645 a year, an assumption [^model]. **Expected effect:** 0 days saved; estimated 4.38 deaths avoided a year (3.21–5.56), arriving only after years [^model]. **Evidence:** The pooled lung cancer mortality rate ratio across nine randomised trials is 0.84 (0.76–0.92) [^ev_ldct_screening_1]. In NELSON it was 0.76 for men at 10 years [^ev_ldct_screening_2]. **Roadmap:** 2.3.4, new national screening programmes [^roadmap_2.3.4].

3. **What:** Cessation medication and counselling for every current smoker at the first pulmonology visit. **Owner:** Chief physician and head nurse of pulmonology. **Cost:** EUR 57,800 a year, an assumption [^model]. **Expected effect:** 0 days saved; estimated 0.45 deaths avoided a year (0.31–0.58) [^model]. **Evidence:** In an observational study, all-cause mortality HR was 0.67 (0.53–0.85) for patients who quit after an early-stage NSCLC diagnosis [^ev_smoking_cessation_at_diagnosis_1]. **Roadmap:** 3.1.2, cancer-specific care pathway descriptions [^roadmap_3.1.2].

## What to measure from Monday
- Date of first symptom and of first primary care contact for every lung cancer patient.
- Date of referral and of first pulmonology visit for suspected lung cancer.
- Dates of first specialist visit, diagnosis and treatment start, recorded per hospital and county.
- Stage at diagnosis and whether treatment intent was curative.

## Limits of this analysis
Step days are county-level estimates built on assumed elasticities, not measurements of individual pathways [^model]. A consistency check (not a validation) found that 0 of 3 measured outcomes correlated with the estimated clock beyond chance [^model]. Curative-intent share went in the expected direction (rho −0.30, p 0.17) [^model]. The national total is held at 155 days, as reported by Yle in 2026 from an unpublished four-city Finnish study [^src_yle_fi_a_74_20250979]. Deaths avoided are modelled, not observed [^model].
